Morgado Golf & Country Club

Portimão, Algarve, Portugal
27-Hole Course Inland Setting Orange Groves

About Morgado Golf & Country Club

Morgado Golf & Country Club sits inland from Portimão, its 27-hole course laid out across old orange groves and rolling countryside rather than along the coast — a different, quieter side of Algarve golf.

The country-club setting suits golfers who want a relaxed base away from the busier beach resorts, while staying close enough to reach the coast in around 15–20 minutes.

Gallery

Hotel Features

  • 27-hole course across three 9-hole loops
  • Inland, countryside setting
  • Outdoor pool and gardens
  • Restaurant overlooking the course
  • Practice range and golf academy
  • 15–20 minute drive to the coast

Golf Course Notes

The three combinable 9-hole loops wind through mature orange groves, giving a distinctly inland, parkland character compared to the Algarve's coastal layouts.
